This supplier disqualification is therefore recorded as a concern that the QP should review before relying on the certification.

concerns.in_short: Supplier (Silverbrook) disqualified after material was used in the lot
concerns.why_it_blocks: SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5 requires a documented traceability and impact assessment for every supplier disqualification and that Quality Assurance decide the outcome (no action / quarantine / customer notification / recall); the Qualified Person must be informed on the effective date. Because the supplier used in this lot was disqualified after supply, these steps are necessary to determine whether any action affecting the lot is required.

citations.ref: sop:SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5#7. Traceability and impact assessment
citations.claim: SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5 requires a traceability and impact assessment for every disqualification.
citations.detail: Quote: "Required at this revision for every disqualification, whether or not any material has been consumed... An assessment that concludes no product was affected is a completed assessment and is recorded as one."

citations.ref: sop:SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5#7. Traceability and impact assessment > 7.3 Outcome
citations.claim: SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5 specifies the possible outcomes QA may decide for each affected lot, including quarantine, customer notification or recall.
citations.detail: Quote: "Quality Assurance decides for each affected lot one of: No action; Quarantine; Customer notification; Recall... The distribution status constrains the available actions and does not by itself decide the outcome."

citations.claim: SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5 prescribes immediate preventive actions for disqualification (quarantine of unused material, block goods receipt, suspend open production orders).
citations.detail: Quote: "All unused material from that supplier is placed in quarantine... Goods receipt is blocked against the supplier... Open production orders drawing on that supplier's material are suspended pending the assessment."

citations.ref: sop:SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5#6. Disqualification > 6.3 Notification to the Qualified Person
citations.claim: SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5 requires the Qualified Person to be informed on the effective date of a disqualification.
citations.detail: Quote: "The Qualified Person for each affected product category is informed on the effective date, before the assessment is complete, and is given the list of batches under assessment as it stands."

citations.ref: sop:SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5#7. Traceability and impact assessment > 7.4 Timescales and records
citations.claim: SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5 sets timescales and record requirements for the assessment and requires recording the outcome and person deciding.
citations.detail: Quote: "The list of affected lots required by §7.1 is completed within five working days of the effective date. The outcome decision required by §7.3 is completed within thirty calendar days... The assessment is recorded against the disqualification with the supplier, the effective date, every material lot and finished lot identified, the classification of each, the outcome decided, and the person deciding."

what_would_clear_it: Complete and record the traceability and impact assessment for the Silverbrook disqualification in accordance with SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5, section 7.
Record Quality Assurance's decision for each affected lot (no action, quarantine, customer notification or recall) and the person deciding, per SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5 §7.3–7.4.
If deviations or receipt issues are identified, raise and record them per SOP-QA-007 (deviation handling) and record any CAPA required per SOP-QA-011, as referenced by SOP-SCM-004 Rev 5.
